turn1.message: I have 30 minutes, solo, no Crucible and no dungeons. What should I do?
drafts:
Do the Edge of Fate mission (Kepler Uplink) — it’s a focused campaign mission you can clear solo in ~15–30 minutes and it advances your active quest. Quick steps:
- Launch Destination > Kepler Uplink (Edge of Fate quest step).  
- Bring a survivable Titan setup: a high-stability/accuracy kinetic (hand cannon or auto) and an energy weapon for add-clear (pulse/SMG), plus Burst/Healing or Overshield recovery mods if you have them.  
- Play deliberately: clear adds, use cover for objectives, pop abilities on groups and the boss window.

If you prefer a shorter, repeatable milestone push: run Vanguard Ops to finish Vanguard milestone progress (matchmade 3-player activity). It’s good for loot and Vanguard rank—queue solo is fine but it may take ~20–30 minutes depending on matchmaking.

If you want, I can: 
- give a quick Titan loadout and mod list tuned for mission speed, or  
- switch the plan to the available Nightfall if you want higher rewards (and tell you expected time/difficulty). Which do you want?

Primary pick — finish the Edge of Fate quest step (Kepler Uplink). It’s an active campaign mission for your Titan with the objective “Complete the mission ‘Kepler Uplink’” currently incomplete. Concrete actions:
- Open Quests and select Edge of Fate → Kepler Uplink, then launch that mission.  
- Loadout suggestion for speed and survivability: a stable, accurate kinetic (hand cannon or auto rifle) + an energy weapon for add-clear; equip grenade/heavy-regen or overshield-supporting mods if you have them, and use your Titan melee/ability to finish grouped adds.  
- Play method: clear adds, finish local objectives, use cover on heavy windows — should fit a 30-minute session in many cases.

What the available account data shows (useful constraints)
- Edge of Fate: active campaign quest with Kepler Uplink objective incomplete.  
- Nightfall: “The Lightblade” is listed as available (Nightfalls are 3-player activities).  
- Vanguard Ops: available to launch (Vanguard activities are 3-player). You’ve recently completed Vanguard Ops runs.  
- Haunted Altars of Sorrow: seasonal activity listed as available.

Important uncertainties
- The data does not establish expected solo clear times or compare loot value between these activities, and it does not prove which activity gives the best rewards.  
- Nightfall/Vanguard Ops are defined for three players but can be matchmade; how long they take when solo depends on matchmaking and difficulty.

Backup option — run a Vanguard Ops for milestone progress (helps finish Weekly Vanguard objectives). It’s matchmade and frequently faster for milestone completion if you want repeatable runs rather than campaign progress.

turn1_drafts:
Short answer: finishing The Final Shape does not automatically unlock every Prismatic fragment. A few Fragments (Facets) unlock during campaign missions, but most are earned afterward by opening Prismatic chests on the Pale Heart (using Memories made from Vestiges of Light / Vestiges of Darkness) or by completing specific named tasks/activities. I checked your Titan’s campaign status with the progression tool and it returned “unknown” (it didn’t return an active quest), so I couldn’t verify your account state from here — but your statement that you finished the campaign is enough to proceed with how to get the remaining fragments.

How to unlock the rest (actionable steps)
1) Know the three main routes
   - Campaign story rewards: a small set of Facets are given during Final Shape missions.  
   - Memories → Prismatic chests on the Pale Heart: most Facets come from chests revealed by Memories.  
   - Named tasks / specific challenges: a few Facets require completing a named task, kill, or objective (these are itemized per-Facet).

2) Farm Vestiges and make Memories (the main repeating loop)
   - Collect Vestiges of Light and Vestiges of Darkness. Five Vestiges of one type combine into a Memory of Light or Memory of Darkness.  
   - Use a Memory to reveal or open the corresponding Prismatic chest(s) on the Pale Heart destination; those chests drop Facets/Fragments.  
   - Repeat until you get the Facets you’re missing.

3) Where to find Vestiges (overview)
   - Vestiges and Prismatic chests are tied to the Pale Heart activity space and its events and encounters. Some Vestiges are obtained from timed Dark/Light chest challenges, world encounters, or small objectives on the Pale Heart. (If you want exact chest locations and which Memory reveals which chest, I can list them.)

4) Finish any named tasks or quests that grant specific Facets
   - A handful of Facets require completion of specific named tasks (for example, killing a named enemy, finishing a specific encounter on the Pale Heart, or completing an associated quest step). These are not automatic and must be completed separately.

5) Track progress and avoid duplication
   - The game shows which Facets you have equipped, but it does not show a full unlock checklist in the same UI—so it helps to keep a personal checklist or use an external list of Facets vs. sources if you want to systematically chase every one.

Quick next steps I can do for you
- If you want exact Memory names, which Memory reveals which chest, and all known chest locations on the Pale Heart, I can list them step-by-step.  
- Or I can check your Titan and report which Prismatic fragments you already have unlocked/equipped and then give a targeted list of the missing ones and where to get each (that requires checking your character data).

Which would you prefer: (A) show exact Memory→chest locations and a general farming route, or (B) have me check your Titan and produce a missing-fragment checklist and directed steps?

Most useful action: collect Vestiges of Light/Darkness on the Pale Heart, combine five into Memories, use those Memories to open Prismatic chests on the Pale Heart, and complete any remaining named Prismatic tasks — that will unlock the majority of Prismatic fragments you don’t already have.

What to do, step-by-step
1) Accept that finishing the campaign only gives a few Facets — most Fragments come from chests and named tasks afterward.  
2) Farm Vestiges of Light and Vestiges of Darkness on the Pale Heart:
   - Play Pale Heart activities, hunt timed chest challenges and world encounters there, and open the small timed Dark/Light chests you find; those sources drop Vestiges.  
   - Collect five Vestiges of the same type (five Light or five Darkness) to create a Memory of Light or Memory of Darkness.  
3) Use Memories to access Prismatic chests:
   - Use a Memory at the indicated prompt or map location for that Memory. That reveals or enables specific Prismatic chest(s) on the Pale Heart. Open the chest(s) to get Facets/Fragments.  
4) Complete named tasks and specific objectives:
   - A handful of Fragments require finishing specific named tasks, kills, or short quest steps on the Pale Heart (or associated encounters). If a Fragment’s description names a task, complete that task directly.  
5) Repeat until you collect every missing Fragment: Vestiges → Memory → chest → repeat. Keep a simple checklist of which Facets you already have so you don’t open the same chests excessively.

In‑game tips and how to check progress
- Open your character’s Fragment/Prismatic menu to see which Facets you have equipped (it doesn’t show a tidy “collected” checklist for all Facets, so note which ones are missing).  
- When you pick up a Vestige it appears in your inventory/quest items until you combine it; carry five of one type, then craft them into a Memory.  
- Many Pale Heart chests are short timed encounters — bring a fireteam if you want faster clears, but they’re doable solo if you’re careful.  
- If a Fragment requires a named kill or specific objective, the Fragment description or the associated pursuit will mention that; follow that objective.

If you want more detail
- I can list known Memory names and the chest locations they reveal on the Pale Heart (step-by-step route).  
- Or I can walk you through an efficient Pale Heart run (route, which encounters to skip, what to prioritize) to optimize Vestige farming.

Which detail would you like: the Memory→chest location list, or an optimized Pale Heart farming route?
